selection: Best EMA checkpoint by class-balanced validation NLL. Choose one shared recipe minimizing mean class-balanced validation NLL across both pilot seeds and all three kernels. No test outcome selects it.
inference: Default argmax, validation-only temperature calibration, and equal-probability five-model ensemble. No target adaptation or test-label threshold selection.
quantum_map: Four RY rotations; CNOT chain; per-wire RZ(theta) then RY(theta/2). Product ablation removes CNOT and second encoding. Fidelity from a compute-uncompute quantum circuit.
quantum_execution: Differentiable 4-qubit gate/statevector simulation in training. Selected entangled ensemble additionally evaluated on every test overlap using batched PennyLane compute-uncompute probabilities. Physical hardware unavailable; no quantum advantage claim.
test_disclosure: The official test set has been inspected repeatedly; all final comparisons are exploratory. Goal 90+ is not guaranteed.
